sections.tldr: TL;DR: The Kurukshetra University online M.Com is a UGC-DEB approved two-year Master of Commerce, delivered fully online. Kurukshetra University holds NAAC A++ accreditation. Offered as a broad M.Com covering the core curriculum. It suits graduates who want a recognised M.Com they can complete online. For the current confirmed fee and EMI options, speak with our counsellor, since the fee for this programme is verified case by case rather than published as a fixed table.

hero.headline: Kurukshetra University Online M.Com
hero.sub: A UGC-DEB approved, NAAC A++ Master of Commerce, delivered online.

ugcDeb.heading: Kurukshetra University Online M.Com: UGC-DEB Approval and Validity
ugcDeb.body: The UGC Distance Education Bureau regulates every online degree in India. Kurukshetra University is UGC-DEB entitled for online delivery, which means this M.Com is valid for government and PSU recruitment, for private-sector employment, and for higher study at recognised Indian universities. Kurukshetra University also holds NAAC A++ accreditation. Always confirm the current entitlement for your admission year at deb.ugc.ac.in before you enrol.

abcId.heading: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC ID)
abcId.body: Every student in a UGC-approved online programme needs an Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) ID. You create it free on the ABC portal at abc.gov.in, usually through your DigiLocker account. As you clear each semester of the Kurukshetra University online M.Com, your credits are deposited against this ID, which makes it easier to carry credits forward or move to a research path, teaching, or a professional finance qualification later. Keep the same ABC ID through the whole two-year programme.

redFlags.heading: What to Check Before You Enrol

flags.sentence1: Kurukshetra University does not publish a single fixed fee table for this online M.Com.
flags.sentence2: Get the current fee and any EMI terms confirmed in writing before you pay, rather than relying on a figure quoted elsewhere.

flags.sentence1: This is a fully online programme with no on-campus classes.
flags.sentence2: If you want in-person teaching or a campus experience, this is not the right format for you.

flags.sentence1: Online study is self-driven and career support is not guaranteed.
flags.sentence2: Plan to build your own study routine, and expect to run your own job search after you graduate.

flags.sentence1: UGC-DEB entitlement is granted intake by intake.
flags.sentence2: Confirm that Kurukshetra University is on the current approved list at deb.ugc.ac.in for your admission year before you enrol.

faqs.question: Is the Kurukshetra University online M.Com valid?
faqs.answer: Yes. Kurukshetra University is UGC-DEB entitled for online delivery and holds NAAC A++. The M.Com is valid for employment, for government and PSU recruitment, and for higher study at recognised Indian universities. Confirm the current status at deb.ugc.ac.in.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the Kurukshetra University online M.Com?
faqs.answer: You need a B.Com or an equivalent bachelor's degree from a recognised university. The online format is built for people who want to study while they work. Confirm the exact cut-off with the university before applying.

faqs.question: How long is the Kurukshetra University online M.Com?
faqs.answer: It is a two-year programme delivered fully online, which lets you study around work or other commitments.

faqs.question: Who should consider the Kurukshetra University online M.Com?
faqs.answer: It suits graduates who want a recognised M.Com they can complete online, and carries local weight around Kurukshetra, Haryana. For the M.Com you would study advanced accounting, corporate finance, taxation and research methods in commerce, and typical early roles include accountant, finance executive, taxation associate. Many graduates go on to a research path, teaching, or a professional finance qualification.

faqs.question: What is the fee for the Kurukshetra University online M.Com?
faqs.answer: The current confirmed fee is verified case by case rather than published as a fixed table. Speak with our counsellor for the latest fee and EMI options, and confirm the figure with the university in writing before you pay.
